responsibility: Implements SHORTCOMPLEX mathematical operations as wrappers over float-precision complex builtins exposed through cbuiltin. It maps the ISO API onto cabsf/cargf/conjf/cpowf/csqrtf/clogf and related trigonometric functions, adds direct polar and scalar-multiplication helpers, and provides the module’s exception-query stub for short complex arithmetic.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the ShortComplexMath pair: it provides the procedure bodies that call cbuiltin complex-float functions and helpers, whereas ShortComplexMath.def only specifies the exported constants and operations.
